records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the one-part working developer with distilled/deionized water at the film-specific dilution and filling temperature in the SPUR development chart. Pre-soaking is not required.
records.reuseInstructions: 250 or 300 ml working solution develops one 35 mm film and must then be discarded. 500 or 600 ml develops two 35 mm films or two 120 films; the two films may be processed together or sequentially without extending the second development time, provided the second film is processed within working-solution shelf life.
records.capacityText: 250-300 ml working solution: one 35 mm film. 500-600 ml working solution: two 35 mm films or two 120 films.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Working solution: 10-14 days in completely filled bottles; storage in a refrigerator can extend working-solution life.
records.storageNotes: Developer concentrate must not be refrigerated and should be stored above 13 C.

records.manufacturer: Hans O. Mahn GmbH & Co. KG / MACO PHOTO PRODUCTS
records.preparation: Dilute concentrate with water according to the Rollei data sheet. For 260 ml working solution: 1+9 uses 26 ml concentrate + 234 ml water; 1+12 uses 20 ml concentrate + 240 ml water; 1+15 uses about 16.25 ml concentrate + 243.75 ml water.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the working solution with distilled water at the film-specific dilution and temperature in the SPUR SLD development chart.
records.capacityText: SPUR specifies a minimum of 6 ml developer concentrate per 35 mm film; if a selected dilution would provide less concentrate, increase working-solution volume accordingly.
records.sourceTitle: SPUR SLD Data Sheet and Development Chart

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the working solution with distilled water using the film-specific dilution, filling temperature and agitation shown in the SPUR Speed-Major chart.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the working solution with distilled water at the film-specific dilution and filling temperature in the SPUR TRX 2000 development chart; harder water requires longer development times.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare Part A at the dilution listed for the film and add Part B according to mode X, Y, Z or 0. Example: 500 ml at 1+14/Z uses 33 ml Part A + 50 ml Part B and distilled water to 500 ml.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Mix Parts A and B in equal amounts. Example: for 260 ml working solution at overall dilution 1+12, use 10 ml Part A + 10 ml Part B and distilled/deionized water to 260 ml.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Part A: at least 2 years in unopened original bottle when stored relatively cool but not refrigerated. Part B: almost unlimited shelf life.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Prepared working solution is short-lived and should be used within the next hours after preparation.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Combine Part A and Part B according to the overall dilution in the development chart. Example: 500 ml at overall dilution 1+20 uses 12 ml Part A + 12 ml Part B and water to 500 ml.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Part A: approximately 2.5-3 years in unopened original bottle when stored relatively cool, not below about 10-12 C. Part B: almost unlimited shelf life.
records.storageNotes: Opened Part A is supplied in gas-tight PET; protective gas helps extend shelf life after opening.
